brief: A sturdy step for my toddler to stand on so they can reach the bathroom sink.

requirements.evidence: No parts placed; 3D-printed Hex Cluster parts with fit-only checks cannot safely support a child's weight.
requirements.requirement: sturdy step for toddler to stand on to reach bathroom sink

finish.summary: Declined: toddler step stool unsafe to build from 3D-printed parts. Nothing placed.
